items.text: The dashboard shows a blocked loop within one five-minute check instead of 45+ minutes later.
Scripts that delete downloaded or unpacked folders now use the delete a Mac filename cannot defeat.
A test that stops its own terminal is confirmed not to be reported as a crash.
+read --help now says a line is a logical line, and why a full-width row can come back glued to the next.
A CLI verb that cannot read Ghoztty's reply now says what it got, not a ten-digit number.
The repo's copy of the website front page matches the live site again.
Settings on Windows draws a section's footer line under its rows, as Mac does.
